Rejects an unknown external finding offset encoding

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    try {
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":[90,97,114,110,97,107],\"filename\":\"external-findings-invalid.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config_Config = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extractWithExternalRedaction(input, config_Config, listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"label\":\"inspection_person\",\"score\":0.99,\"text\":\"Zarnak\"}", ExternalRedactionFinding::class.java)), "bytes-ish", 8)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
